tasks.title: Inventory Occurrences of Brand Text
tasks.description: Generate a findings file of all candidate occurrences of the brand text 'Univer' in user-facing files.
tasks.details: Use a case-insensitive search to identify occurrences of 'Univer', 'UNIVER', 'Univer Sheets', and 'UniverJS' in user-facing files such as .html, .md, .ts, .tsx, and .json. Exclude directories like node_modules/, dist/, and coverage outputs. Tag and separate exclusions such as imports, URLs, and changelog history.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the findings file includes all occurrences in the specified files and excludes the specified directories and exclusions.

tasks.title: Define Replacement Rules
tasks.description: Lock the casing and phrase rules for the brand text replacement and confirm exclusions with stakeholders.
tasks.details: Establish the replacement rules: 'Univer Sheets' to 'Strique Sheets', 'Univer' to 'Strique', 'UNIVER' to 'STRIQUE', and 'UniverJS' to 'Strique' (visible brand text only). Confirm with stakeholders that exclusions such as @univerjs/* imports, URLs, code identifiers, historical references in CHANGELOG, and third-party legal attributions are correct. Prioritize phrase-level replacements first to avoid double substitutions. Limit automated replacements to user-facing file types: .html, .md, .ts, .tsx, .json, .txt. Conduct manual review for high-value files after each phase.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure all replacement rules are documented and confirmed by stakeholders. Verify exclusions are agreed upon. Conduct manual reviews for high-value files to ensure accuracy.

tasks.title: Update HTML Titles and Metadata
tasks.description: Apply brand text updates to HTML titles and metadata in the examples/public directory.
tasks.details: Use the defined replacement rules to update HTML titles and metadata in the examples/public directory. Ensure that all occurrences of 'Univer' and related terms are replaced according to the rules.
tasks.testStrategy: Manually review updated HTML files to ensure all titles and metadata reflect the new brand text.

tasks.title: Update UI Strings in Source Files
tasks.description: Apply brand text updates to visible UI strings in the examples/src directory.
tasks.details: Use the replacement rules to update visible UI strings in the examples/src directory, focusing on .ts and .tsx files. Ensure that all occurrences of 'Univer' and related terms are replaced according to the rules.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the application and manually verify that UI strings display the new brand text correctly.

tasks.title: Update Storybook and Demo Titles
tasks.description: Apply brand text updates to Storybook and demo titles if present.
tasks.details: Use the replacement rules to update Storybook and demo titles, ensuring all occurrences of 'Univer' and related terms are replaced according to the rules.
tasks.testStrategy: Run Storybook and manually verify that all titles reflect the new brand text.

tasks.title: Update Documentation
tasks.description: Apply brand text updates to top-level documentation files.
tasks.details: Use the replacement rules to update top-level documentation files, including README*.md and docs/**/*, ensuring all occurrences of 'Univer' and related terms are replaced according to the rules.
tasks.testStrategy: Manually review documentation files to ensure all occurrences reflect the new brand text.

tasks.title: Run Unit and Snapshot Tests
tasks.description: Execute unit and snapshot tests to verify branding changes.
tasks.details: Run existing unit and snapshot tests to ensure they pass with the new brand text. Update snapshots where branding is asserted.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure all tests pass and updated snapshots correctly reflect the new brand text.

tasks.title: Manual Spot-Check of High-Value Files
tasks.description: Perform a manual spot-check of high-value files to ensure correct branding updates.
tasks.details: Manually review high-value files such as examples/public/index.html, examples/src/**/*, Storybook configs, README*.md, and docs/**/* to ensure all branding updates are correct.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that all manually checked files reflect the new brand text accurately.

tasks.title: Final Global Search and Validation
tasks.description: Re-run global search to confirm no lingering occurrences of old brand text.
tasks.details: Perform a final global search to ensure no lingering occurrences of 'Univer' or related terms remain, except in excluded areas. Validate that exclusions have not been modified.
tasks.testStrategy: Confirm that the final search results show no occurrences of the old brand text outside of excluded areas.

tasks.title: Stakeholder Sign-off
tasks.description: Collect sign-off from stakeholders to confirm completion of branding updates.
tasks.details: Present the final results to stakeholders for review and approval. Ensure all branding updates meet the acceptance criteria outlined in the PRD.
tasks.testStrategy: Obtain formal approval from stakeholders confirming that all branding updates are complete and accurate.
